file_name: BBFIT - Hanes Australasia - Third Party Questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if BBFIT (including Best & Less and Léays) and Hanes Australasia (including Bonds, Bras N Things and Berlei) are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with BBFIT and/or Hanes Australasia.
